boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's wm_standard.c, 0x02061d30..0x020623ec: 13 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Every body compiles byte-identical with the signatures, locals and WM_CHECK_RESULT shape of ntrtwl/NitroSDK libraries/wm/src/wm_standard.c; this older SDK sends WM_Enable and WM_Initialize's three buffers without miscFlags, sends START_PARENT with no powerSave, writes the scan and connect requests straight into the ARM9-to-ARM7 command block, and checks the MP exchange time in WmCheckParentParameter.

Order: mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse. The SDK file's order (WM_Enable, WM_Disable, WM_PowerOn, WM_PowerOff, WM_Initialize, WM_Reset, WM_End, WM_SetParentParameter, WmCheckParentParameter, WM_StartParent, WM_StartScan, WM_StartConnect, WM_Disconnect, with the uncalled WM_EndParent, WM_StartScanEx, WM_EndScan and WM_DisconnectChildren absent) is the ROM's order reversed, as in pret's pokediamond WM_standard.s.
WmCheckParentParameter is static, as in the SDK; it is not inlined into its one caller.
No data: no function owns .rodata, .data or .bss.
BOTTOM EDGE: the wm_sync.c run (src/engine/wm/WM_Sync.c) ends at 0x02061d30 with WM_SetIndCallback. TOP EDGE: the wm_mp.c run (src/engine/wm/WM_Mp.c) starts at 0x020623ec.
notes: HAND-BUILT manifest entry, not tools/tubuild.py create output: tu_map does not segment arm9.
Built as C, like the SDK. The prototypes are declared in include/nitro/wm/wm_api.h; WMBssDesc, WMParentParam and WMScanParam are in include/nitro/wm/wm.h.
